title: The Verdict: Why two true stories were read as one
text: Systems, a thin unnamed disputes tool, three functions, one source, and a voice bot with a real headcount, a real reversal, and an on-record admission. Neither one is the other. Five entries in this series keeps finding the same reporting failure. Real systems, real events merged by outside coverage into one cleaner story. The rule that survives this, when an AI story and a layoff story get told together, check whether the primary sources actually name the same tool. Your turn.
